GraceTechnology.Runtime: uvicorn (ASGI), browser via Vite 8 dev server or nginx in Docker
GraceTechnology.Framework: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 async + asyncpg, Alembic, pydantic-settings, httpx; React 19, TanStack Query 5, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui (radix), openapi-fetch + openapi-typescript
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: Tests are banned in this project (no unit, integration or e2e tests, no test frameworks). Evidence comes from static gates: make gate-backend (ruff + ruff format --check + mypy strict), make gate-frontend (oxlint + steiger FSD lint + tsc + vite build), make gate-openapi (API contract drift), make gate-compose (docker compose config), grace lint and grace status drift.
GraceTechnology.Observability: Python logging with [Module][function][BLOCK_*] prefixes for Keitaro calls, creator and editor mutations.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Package managers: uv for apps/backend, npm for apps/frontend.
Frontend follows Feature-Sliced Design: layers app, pages, widgets, features, entities, shared; imports only point downward; every slice exposes index.ts public API; enforced by steiger.
Frontend API types are generated from contracts/openapi.json; never hand-edit apps/frontend/src/shared/api/schema.d.ts.
